svg.text: MPx-SQ2-001/002 · Inlet cap and built-in prefilter
MPx Squeeze v2 (Mini) · IISc CPDM · preliminary, not for manufacture
1. Bottle thread 28 PCO 1881 internal, major Ø28.4 / minor Ø26.0; confirm starts on 5 local bottles first (as v1).
2. Gasket S1 on the web face at 15.5; the bottle lip compresses it ~0.4 mm. The prefilter passes through the lip.
3. M48×1.0-6H from 21.0 to 28.7. Land at 19.5 carries the S2 face groove (Ø40.5/Ø43.5 × 1.15 deep).
4. 8 radial roof ribs 1.2 wide, 2.3 high, r 7.5–19, at 22.5° + n·45°: they hold the disc during backflush.
5. Prefilter: press collar 2a into the Ø15 H7 bore, laser-weld round from the chamber side, then weld cup 2 to the flange.
6. Diamond knurl 0.8 pitch on Ø52 from 15.5 to 28.7; break sharp edges 0.2.
keeps sand, hair, fibres, ≥ 20 µm off the disc
